name: Form: Unpublish

description.en: Remove a form from the Form store while keeping its public form URL active. Existing installed copies are not affected.
description.de: Entferne ein Formular aus dem Formular-Store, ohne seine öffentliche Formular-URL zu deaktivieren. Bereits installierte Kopien bleiben bestehen.

bot: Use this when the user wants to stop offering a form for installation without deleting it.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that owns this form. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug, dem dieses Formular gehört. Standardmäßig wird das aktuelle Team verwendet.

inputs.bot: Pass the business team slug that owns the form (e.g. lernstudio-satzinger). Omit to use the current team. Required when the form belongs to a different team than the agent home team.

success.en: Form removed from the Form store.
